outcome: completion of the Maternal and Child Health (MCH) continuum of care
cohort: Mothers with children aged 9-18 months residing in Habru district, northeast Ethiopia.
finding: The prevalence of mothers who completed the MCH continuum of care was 25.3%, with education, early initiation of ANC, and awareness of MCH services identified as significant determinants.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was significantly associated with the completion of the MCH continuum of care.
